tagline: Focaccia & Italian street food from a converted outhouse in Offerton.
storyText:
La Cucina Povera — 'the poor kitchen' — started in a converted outhouse round the back of a house in Offerton. Not a restaurant. Not a café. A fabricated space turned into something worth finding.

Focaccia baked fresh, stuffed properly, wrapped in greaseproof and passed out the back. Honest food, real ingredients, no shortcuts. The kind of thing you'd eat standing up and not regret.
